# ModernKit v1.5.9 — Obsidian Gear, Rainbow Blocks & Material Slabs

A big content update: a full Obsidian equipment set with its own custom 3D armor model, Obsidian and Rainbow building blocks, slabs for five vanilla materials, and a survival bug fix.

## 🪨 Obsidian Equipment

- **Obsidian Sword, Pickaxe, Axe and Shovel** — dark purple obsidian tools, one step above Diamond: 2048 durability, faster mining, and the Sword hits for 13 damage. Crafted from Obsidian in the standard tool shapes.
- **Obsidian Armor (Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings, Boots)** — Diamond-level protection with Netherite-level toughness, 40 uses per armor point, and repairable with Obsidian. Crafted from Obsidian in the standard armor shapes.

## 🛡️ Custom 3D Obsidian Armor Model

Obsidian Armor does not use the standard vanilla armor shape — it has its own 3D model in the same style as the Emerald and Rainbow armor sets:

- **Helmet** — jagged crest fin down the center, two swept-back horn spikes, and side cheek guards.
- **Chestplate** — layered chest plate with a protruding gem shard, an abdomen plate, and a full back plate.
- **Pauldrons** — heavy shoulder caps with side plates and top spikes.
- **Leggings** — belt buckle, hip side plates, and thigh and knee plates.
- **Boots** — cuff rings and protruding toe caps.

All pieces use the obsidian purple-black palette to match the gear icons.

## 🧱 Obsidian & Rainbow Blocks

- **Obsidian Stairs, Slab and Door** — build with obsidian at last. The door has window panes, opens by hand, and zombies can't break it down.
- **Rainbow Block, Slab and Door** — the rainbow gear's animated shimmer, now as placeable blocks. The rainbow layers animate in your hand, in your inventory and when placed.
- Craft the Rainbow Block from 9 Rainbow Ingots; slabs give 6, doors give 3.

## 🟨 Material Slabs

- **Gold, Diamond, Emerald, Coal and Redstone Slabs** — half-size versions of the vanilla blocks, crafted from 3 of each block (makes 6).

## 🐛 Fixes

- **Heavy Core now drops itself in survival** — placing it worked since v1.5.82, but breaking a placed Heavy Core gave nothing back. Fixed.

## 📦 Compatibility

- **Minecraft:** 1.16.5 (Fabric)
- **Requires:** Fabric API and Fabric Loader 0.14.21 (or newer)
- **Works with:** Sodium and Iris — Sodium held-item compatibility is built into the mod
- **Both sides:** install on the client and the server
